svg.title: StateKV architecture: state-conditioned physical evaluation and a training-free direct policy
svg.desc: A detailed scientific architecture diagram showing how compression history defines the current functional state, how candidate retained sets are physically evaluated and ranked, how selection feeds back into later states, and how the current training-free direct policy bypasses candidate enumeration.
